originalTitle: South Africa's deputy police chief resigns after being charged with sexual offences
title: A Big Police Boss Leaves His Job in Sunny South Africa!
content:
Hi, wonderful young friends all across Africa! Your friend News Kid Nala is here with some important news from a beautiful country called South Africa. It’s a bit of a serious story, but it’s really important for us to understand how things work when rules are broken, even by very important people.

Hello from News Kid Nala!

Today, we're talking about a very special kind of helper in our communities: the police. Police officers work hard to keep us safe, protect our families, and make sure everyone follows the rules, or 'laws,' of the country.

In South Africa, there was a very, very important police boss. His name is Mr. Shadrack Sibiya. Imagine having a big, important job where you help lead all the police officers to keep everyone safe! That was his big job.

A Big Boss Leaves His Police Job

Now, sometimes, even people with very big jobs might face challenges. Mr. Sibiya had to leave his important job. When someone leaves their job like this, it’s called 'resigning.' It means he chose to stop working as one of the main leaders for the police.

Think of it like a captain of a football team deciding to step down because something serious happened. He's not the captain anymore.

Did you know? South Africa is a country at the very bottom tip of Africa! It's famous for its amazing wildlife, like lions, elephants, and giraffes, and beautiful beaches!

What Did He Do?

So, why did Mr. Sibiya leave his job? Well, he was accused of doing some very, very wrong and hurtful things. These things were against the law, especially when it comes to young people.

He was accused of being unkind and doing things that are not allowed with a 16-year-old young person and another 18-year-old young person. These are very serious accusations, meaning someone said he did these bad things.

When someone is 'accused,' it means people are saying they did something wrong. It doesn't mean they *definitely* did it yet, but it means there will be a special look into what happened to find out the truth.

Mr. Sibiya said, 'No, I didn't do these things.' He denied the accusations. But because the accusations were so serious, he decided to leave his big job while the truth is being found out.

Why Is This Important News?

This story is important because it teaches us a big lesson: everyone, no matter how important they are, must follow the law. Whether you are a big police boss, a teacher, a parent, or even a kid, there are rules, or 'laws,' for all of us.

Laws are like big, important rules that a whole country follows. They are made to keep everyone safe and happy. If someone breaks a law, there are special places called 'courts' where people try to find out what happened and make sure fairness, or 'justice,' is served.

It shows that nobody is above the law. Even a very important leader in the police must face questions if they are accused of breaking the rules.

Did you know? The police often wear special uniforms so you can easily spot them when you need help!

What Happens Next?

Even though Mr. Sibiya left his job, the accusations against him are still there. This means there will be a special investigation, like a big puzzle to solve, and maybe a court case.

In a court, a special grown-up called a 'judge' listens to all the information. The judge is like a very wise grown-up who tries to understand everything very carefully. The judge will listen to both sides and decide if Mr. Sibiya really did those wrong things or not.

Everyone gets a chance to tell their side of the story in court. This is how we make sure that justice is fair for everyone.

Staying Safe is Super Important!

This story might sound a bit serious, but it also reminds us of something very, very important: always tell a grown-up you trust if someone does something that makes you feel unsafe, uncomfortable, or sad. It could be your mom, dad, a teacher, an aunt, an uncle, or any trusted adult.

They will listen to you and help you. It's brave to speak up!

Remember, most police officers are good people who want to help you. They are your friends! This one story is just about one person. The system of law and justice is there to protect everyone, especially young people, from harm.

It makes sure that if someone does something wrong, they are held responsible for their actions. We want all young people to feel safe, happy, and protected in our wonderful continent of Africa!
summary: A very important police boss in South Africa, Mr. Shadrack Sibiya, left his job after being accused of doing very wrong and hurtful things to young people, and now a special investigation will find out the truth.
whyMatters: This story matters because it shows that everyone, even very important people, must follow the law and face justice if they are accused of doing bad things, and it reminds us to always tell a trusted grown-up if we feel unsafe.

originalTitle: Jerusalem Daily: Israeli forces raid NGOs in Ramallah
title: A Big Visit to Helper Homes in a Faraway City!
content:
Jambo, amazing friends from Africa! It’s your friendly news reporter here, ready to take you on another adventure to learn about our big, beautiful world! Today, we’re going to talk about something that happened far, far away, in a city called Ramallah. It sounds like a fun word to say, doesn't it? Ramallah!

A Visit to Helper Houses Far Away

Imagine you have a friend who is building a wonderful treehouse for everyone to play in. It's a special place where friends can get snacks, play games, and feel safe. Now, imagine some adults who are in charge of the whole park come to visit your friend's treehouse, maybe to look around and check on things. This is a bit like what happened in Ramallah. In Ramallah, there are special places we call "helper houses" or "helper groups." In big-people language, these are called NGOs. We'll learn more about them soon! These helper houses are like your friend's treehouse, but instead of games, they help people with very important things like food, water, and even learning. What happened was that some "Israeli forces" came to visit these helper houses in Ramallah. What are "forces"? Well, imagine people who wear uniforms and work to keep things orderly and safe for a country, like police officers or soldiers. They are people whose job it is to look after their country. And what does "raid" mean? It sounds a bit like a pirate word, doesn't it? But it just means they made a sudden, big visit to these helper houses. They looked around, checked things, and gathered some information. It was a surprise visit, a bit like when your teacher makes a surprise check on your homework!

What are these "Helper Houses" called NGOs?

Now, let's talk about those fantastic helper houses, the NGOs! NGO stands for **Non-Governmental Organization**. That's a long name, right? Just think of it as "Not a Government Helper Group." These NGOs are groups of kind people who want to help others. They are not part of a government, but they do amazing work all over the world, just like kind people in your own community might help a neighbour. **Did you know?** There are thousands and thousands of NGOs around the world! They work to make life better for everyone. Some bring clean water to villages, some build schools for children who can't go to school, and some help doctors look after people who are sick. They are truly super helpers! In Ramallah, these NGOs do lots of good things. They might give food to families who don't have enough, or give school books to children so they can learn to read and write. Some even help people find safe places to live if their homes are not safe anymore. They are like a big, warm hug for the community.

Who are the Israeli Forces?

You heard about the "Israeli forces" earlier. These are people from a country called Israel. Just like every country has people who work to keep it safe and orderly, Israel has its forces. Their job is to protect their country and its people. Sometimes, they need to check on things in nearby areas, especially if they think there might be problems or if they need to find information. It's part of how they try to keep everyone safe.

Where is Ramallah?

Let's zoom out on our world map! Ramallah is a city in a place called Palestine. Imagine your country, then imagine another country right next door or a little bit away. That's a bit like Palestine and Israel. Ramallah is a busy city, full of people, markets, and homes. It's not too far from another very famous city you might have heard of called Jerusalem. **Did you know?** Jerusalem is a very old city, thousands of years old! Many different people from different religions consider it a very special and holy place. It has beautiful old buildings and stories that go back a very, very long time. People from all over the world visit Jerusalem because it's so important. So, Ramallah is a city where many people live their daily lives, go to school, work, and yes, where these helper houses (NGOs) do their important work.

Why Did This Happen?

Sometimes, when groups of people are helping others, governments or forces want to check on them. It's a bit like when your parents ask you what you are doing with your pocket money. They want to make sure you are using it in a good way, right? The Israeli forces might have visited these helper houses in Ramallah to look for information or to check on what they were doing. Sometimes, there can be disagreements or different rules that people need to follow. It's a complicated situation, like when friends have a disagreement and need to talk about it. It's important to remember that even when things like this happen, the helper groups (NGOs) usually want to keep doing their good work, helping children and families who need them. They want to make sure everyone has what they need to live a happy and healthy life.

What Does It All Mean for Us?

So, what can we learn from this news from far away? First, it teaches us that our world is big and full of different places and different people. It's good to learn about them! Second, it reminds us how important it is for people to help each other. Those NGOs are doing wonderful work, trying to make the world a better place. You can be a helper too! **Did you know?** Even you, as a young person, can be a helper! You can help your family, your friends, or your community. Maybe you can share your toys, help clean up, or be kind to someone who is sad. Every little bit of help makes a big difference! Even when there are visits from forces or tricky situations, the spirit of helping others shines bright. It’s important to understand that sometimes things happen that are complex, but we can always focus on kindness and trying to make the world a better place. Thank you for exploring with me today, amazing friends! Keep shining bright and remember to be kind to everyone you meet! Until next time!
summary: In a faraway city called Ramallah, people who work to keep order (Israeli forces) visited special groups (NGOs) that help others with things like food and school, reminding us how important it is to learn about our world and help each other.
whyMatters: This matters because it helps us learn about a different part of the world and understand that even when things are tricky, many people are working hard to help others, just like we can help our friends and family.

originalTitle: Drivers queue for hours in Bali amid fuel shortage
title: Cars Wait and Wait! What's Happening Far Away in Bali?
content:
Hey there, awesome kids from Africa! Your friend, the kid reporter, is here with some news from a place far, far away. It's an island called Bali, full of sunshine and beaches, like some parts of our beautiful Africa! But guess what? Something tricky is happening there. People are having to wait for a very long time, just to get fuel for their cars!

What is Fuel?

Let's talk about 'fuel' first. Do you know what makes a car go 'vroom vroom' and move? It's fuel! It's a special kind of liquid, often called petrol or gasoline. Cars need fuel like you need food to play and run around. Without fuel, cars just sit still. They can't take people to school, to work, or even to the market. Did you know? The fuel we use for cars comes from deep, deep inside the Earth! It's like a special treasure found underground.

A Shortage of Fuel

Now, imagine you want a yummy biscuit, but there are no biscuits left in the jar! That's a 'shortage'. It means there is not enough of something. In Bali, right now, there is a shortage of fuel. This means the shops where cars get fuel, called 'fuel stations', don't have enough for everyone. Because there isn't enough fuel, many drivers are worried. They need fuel to do their daily jobs and travel. It's a bit like when you need water, but the tap is only dripping slowly.

Waiting in Long, Long Lines

When there's not enough of something, what do people do? They wait! In Bali, drivers are waiting in very, very long lines, called 'queues'. Imagine a line of cars that stretches for miles! People sometimes wait for hours and hours, just to get a little bit of fuel. Can you imagine waiting that long for anything? It must be quite boring and hot under the sun! Did you know? Waiting patiently is very important, even if it's boring. It helps everyone get their turn fairly.

Why is This Happening in Bali?

This special fuel in Bali is called 'Pertalite fuel'. The government in Indonesia (that's the country Bali is part of) helps to make this fuel cheaper for people. This is called 'subsidised' fuel. It means the government pays a part of the cost, so it doesn't cost too much money for people to buy. But right now, there isn't enough of this special, cheaper fuel. Maybe the factories making the fuel are having problems, or perhaps too many people are using it. When there's a big demand (lots of people wanting it) and not enough supply (not enough available), shortages can happen. Did you know? Some cars don't use fuel at all! They use electricity, like your TV or a phone, to power their engines. These are called electric cars!

Who Feels It Most?

Think about all the people who need cars. Mums and dads going to work, taxis taking people places, big trucks delivering food and other things to shops. All these people need fuel. When there's not enough, it makes life very hard. Kids might not get to school on time. Parents might be late for work. Food might not get to the market. It's not just about the cars, but about all the people who rely on them every day. It's a big problem for everyone in Bali.

What Happens When There's No Fuel?

If a car runs out of fuel, it simply stops. It can't go anywhere. So, some people in Bali who can't get fuel might have to find other ways to travel. Maybe they walk, or ride bicycles, or take a bus if buses still have fuel. It reminds us how important cars and fuel are for modern life. Did you know? In some places, people use bicycles for almost everything, like going to school or even carrying goods! It's a healthy way to travel.

Learning from Far Away

Even though Bali is very far from us in Africa, we can still learn from what's happening there. It shows us that sometimes, things can be tricky in different parts of the world. It helps us understand how important things like fuel are for people's daily lives and how we all rely on many different things to make our world go 'round. Did you know? Patience is like a superpower! When you have to wait for something, being patient makes it easier for everyone.

A Hope for Bali

We hope that the people in Bali find a solution very soon. Maybe the government will find more fuel, or people will find other good ways to travel until things get better. We send our kind thoughts to all the drivers and families in Bali who are waiting so patiently. It shows how strong and determined people can be, even when things are tough! Keep shining, Bali!
summary: Drivers on the sunny island of Bali are waiting in very long lines for hours to get fuel for their cars because there isn't enough of the special, cheaper fuel called Pertalite.
whyMatters: This is important because without enough fuel, cars can't move, which makes it hard for people to go to school, work, or get important things like food, showing us how we rely on fuel every day.

originalTitle: Horrified witnesses recount fatal rollercoaster incident at Six Flags
title: Playing Safely at Fun Parks Around the World
content:
Hello, My Little Friends!

Hello, hello, my wonderful little friends! It's your friend here, bringing you news from our beautiful continent, Africa. Today, I want to talk about something important, something that helps us all stay safe and have lots of fun. Sometimes, news can be a little bit sad, but it's always good to learn from everything that happens. This helps us grow into smart and careful big kids!

What is a Fun Park?

Have you ever seen pictures of a big, exciting fun park? Or maybe you've been lucky enough to visit one? These places are sometimes called amusement parks! They are super special places that are built for laughter and big smiles. Imagine a giant playground, but with even bigger and faster rides! People go to fun parks to have an amazing day. They go with their families and friends. They want to make happy memories and feel excited.

Rollercoasters: Big Fun!

One of the most exciting rides you can find at a fun park is called a rollercoaster. Wow! Rollercoasters are usually very, very big. They have long, twisty tracks that go way up high into the sky. Then, they zoom super fast down, down, down! It feels like flying! Many grown-ups and bigger children love the thrilling speed and the exciting drops. It's a real adventure! Clever people called engineers design and build these rollercoasters. They work very hard to make sure every ride is strong and safe for everyone to enjoy.

A Sad Story from Far Away

Now, sometimes, even in places that are built for so much fun, a sad thing can happen. We heard a story from a country far away, called America. In a big fun park there, something very sad happened on one of the rides. A grown-up man got hurt very badly. The police and other helpers are looking into it very carefully. They want to understand exactly what happened. It seems like the man might have fallen from the ride. This is a very sad event for everyone, especially for his family and friends. When something sad happens, we all feel a little quiet and think about how we can be even more careful.

Why Rules are Super Important

This sad story reminds us of something truly important: rules! Do you know why we have rules, my little friends? Rules are like special helpers. They are there to keep us safe and sound wherever we go. We have rules at home, at school, and especially when we play! At fun parks, there are lots of rules for all the rides. These rules are not there to stop your fun. Instead, they are there to protect every single person who wants to have a good time. For example, some rides have height rules. This means you must be a certain height to ride. It's not to be mean! It's to make sure that the safety belts and bars fit you perfectly and keep you snug in your seat. There are also rules to always keep your hands and feet inside the ride. And to stay in your seat until the ride stops completely. These rules are like a shield, keeping you protected. Listening to the grown-ups who work at the park is also a super important rule. They are there to guide you, help you, and keep an eye on everything to make sure everyone is safe.

Did you know? Fun Facts About Ride Safety!

**Did you know?** Every single morning, before any fun park opens, special workers check every single ride! They make sure all the bolts are tight and that everything is working perfectly. It's like checking your bicycle tires before you go for a ride! **Did you know?** When a brand new ride is built, special teams of people test it many, many times! They try it out over and over again before anyone else is allowed to get on it. They do this to make sure it's super, super safe. **Did you know?** The safety bar that comes down over your lap on a rollercoaster is called a "restraint." It's like a strong, safe hug that keeps you secure in your seat, no matter how fast you go! These safety checks and rules are done all the time. This is to make sure that having fun is always safe fun!

Learning from Everything

When something sad happens, like the story we shared today, people work extra hard. They want to understand exactly why it happened. They ask many questions and look at all the clues. The police and the helpers at the park will look at everything very carefully. They want to learn from this sad event. Their biggest wish is to make sure nothing like this ever happens again. It's a bit like when you accidentally spill your juice. You learn to hold your cup more carefully next time, right? People learn from what happens and work to make things better and safer for everyone in the future.

A Message to My African Friends

So, my dear little friends, remember to always play safely. Whether you are playing at home, at school, or if you ever get to visit a big fun park. Always listen to your parents, your teachers, and any grown-ups who are looking after you. They give you rules because they love you very much and want you to be happy and safe. Let's all promise to always follow the rules, laugh lots, and have wonderful, safe adventures every single day. From your friend, right here in Africa, wishing you a day full of happy and safe fun!
summary: A sad event happened at a big fun park far away, where a grown-up got hurt very badly on a ride, and now people are working hard to understand what happened and make sure all rides are even safer.
whyMatters: It teaches us that rules are super important to keep everyone safe when we play, especially on big, exciting rides, so we can always have fun without worries.

originalTitle: Breaking Bad actor RJ Mitte dies aged 34
title: A Sad Goodbye to Our Friend RJ Mitte, a Star Who Shined Bright!
content:
Hello, My Amazing Friends Across Africa!

Hi everyone! It’s your kid-friendly news reporter here, bringing you some news from around the world. Sometimes, the news can be a little bit sad, but even sad news can teach us important lessons about kindness and being strong. Today, we have some sad news to share with you. A wonderful man, an actor who made many people smile and think, has passed away. His name was RJ Mitte. He was 34 years old, which is not very old at all. When someone "passes away," it means they have gone to sleep forever. It means they have died. We are sad, but we will remember all the good things RJ Mitte did during his life. He truly was a special person, and he taught us so much about being kind and believing in ourselves. Let's learn more about him and why he was so important.

Who Was RJ Mitte, Our Shining Star?

RJ Mitte was an actor. What is an actor, you ask? Well, an actor is like a super storyteller! They pretend to be different people and play make-believe characters in movies or on TV shows. They can make us laugh, cry, or think really hard. RJ Mitte was a very talented actor. He lived far, far away in a country called America, but his work touched hearts all over the world, even here in Africa! He became famous for playing a character on a very popular TV show. But what made RJ Mitte extra special was something called cerebral palsy. This is an important part of his story, and we should learn about it together.

What is Cerebral Palsy? Let's Learn!

Now, let's talk about "cerebral palsy" in a simple way. It might sound like a big, difficult word, but it's not too scary! Cerebral palsy, or CP for short, is something that some people are born with, or they get it when they are very young. It means that their brain and their muscles sometimes have a little trouble talking to each other. This can make it hard for their body to move in exactly the way they want it to. For example, some people with cerebral palsy might walk with a special sway, or they might use a walking stick or even a special chair with wheels to help them move around. It's not a sickness that you can catch, like a cold or the flu. You can’t get it from touching someone. It’s just how some people's bodies work. But here’s the most important part: having cerebral palsy does not mean a person isn't smart, kind, or able to do amazing things! People with CP have bright minds, big hearts, and wonderful dreams, just like everyone else. RJ Mitte was a perfect example of this!

RJ Mitte: A TV Star Who Made a Difference!

RJ Mitte was best known for playing a character named Walter White Jr. in a very famous TV show called "Breaking Bad." A TV show is like a long story told in many parts, shown on your television set. In this show, RJ Mitte's character, Walter White Jr., also had cerebral palsy, just like RJ in real life! This was super important! Why? Because it showed millions and millions of people all around the world what it's like to live with cerebral palsy. When you see someone like RJ on TV, moving and talking, it helps you understand them better. It helps you see that people with different abilities are just like you and me – they have families, friends, dreams, and talents. His acting helped to teach kindness and understanding to so many. He was not just acting; he was also teaching the world an important lesson.

Did You Know? Fun Facts!

**Did you know?** There are many different kinds of TV shows! Some are cartoons, some tell stories about animals, and some are like long plays with real actors, just like "Breaking Bad." Some of the shows you watch with your family might even be from other countries! **Did you know?** Sometimes, actors have to pretend to have different accents or learn new skills, like riding a horse or playing a musical instrument, for their roles! It takes a lot of practice and hard work! **Did you know?** People with cerebral palsy can be doctors, teachers, artists, musicians, and yes, even famous actors! They can achieve anything they set their minds to and work hard for. They are full of talent and ideas. **Did you know?** The brain is like the super-computer of your body! It tells your hands to wave, your legs to run, and your mouth to talk. For people with CP, sometimes the messages from the brain to the muscles get a little mixed up, making movements harder.

A Big Award for a Great Show!

The TV show "Breaking Bad," where RJ Mitte was a shining star, won many, many special prizes called "Emmy Awards." An Emmy Award is like a big, fancy trophy or a gold medal that people give to TV shows and actors who are super, super good at what they do. It means that many clever grown-ups who watch lots of TV shows thought "Breaking Bad" was one of the best shows ever! And RJ Mitte, with his amazing acting, was a big part of why that show was so wonderful and won so many awards. He truly helped make it special and memorable for everyone who watched it. Winning an Emmy is a huge honor, and it showed how much people appreciated the hard work and talent of RJ and everyone else involved.

RJ Mitte's Important Message for Everyone

RJ Mitte didn't just stop at acting. He used his voice to help others and share a very important message with the world. He talked to lots of children and grown-ups, teaching them about understanding and kindness. He always said that no matter how someone looks, or if their body works a little differently, they are still wonderful, smart, and valuable people. He wanted everyone to know that it's important to be friendly to everyone, to help each other, and to never make fun of someone just because they are different. He helped to make the world a kinder place by sharing his own story and encouraging everyone to be more understanding and accepting of others. His message was simple: treat everyone with respect and see the good in them.

Dream Big, Just Like RJ Mitte!

RJ Mitte showed all of us that you can chase your dreams and make them come true, no matter what challenges you might face. He had cerebral palsy, but he didn't let that stop him from becoming a famous actor who starred in a super popular TV show! His life teaches us a powerful lesson: if you work hard, if you believe in yourself, and if you never give up, you can do amazing things. It doesn't matter if you have to do things a little differently, or if your body works in a special way. What truly matters is your heart, your brain, and how much you want to achieve your dreams. Every child in Africa, and everywhere else, should remember RJ Mitte's story and know that they can also reach for the stars! Keep dreaming big, just like RJ did!

Remembering Our Kind Friend, RJ Mitte

It is very sad that RJ Mitte is no longer with us. When someone kind and special leaves us, it makes our hearts feel a little heavy. But even though we are sad, we can also feel happy and thankful for all the good things he did and all the important lessons he taught us. We will remember his bright smile, his brave spirit, and how he helped so many people learn about kindness and understanding. Let’s all promise to be kind to everyone around us, to help our friends, and to welcome people who are different, just like RJ Mitte showed us. He may be gone, but his message will live on in our hearts. Thank you, RJ, for being such a wonderful example. Goodbye for now, dear friend.
summary: RJ Mitte, a kind actor who lived with cerebral palsy, showed us that anyone can achieve their dreams and taught us to be kind and understanding to everyone, especially by starring in the famous TV show "Breaking Bad."
whyMatters: His life teaches us that it's important to be kind and understand people who are different, and that everyone can follow their dreams, no matter what challenges they face.

originalTitle: Football regulator says he would quit over Man City political interference
title: Kickin' It Fair: A Big Boss Says Rules Rule!
content:
Hello, Football Friends!

Welcome to our super exciting news show, right here from Africa! I'm your friendly reporter, ready to share some amazing stories. Today, we're talking about something super important for football – fairness! Do you love football? Kicking the ball with your friends, running fast, scoring a goal? It's one of the most fun games in the whole wide world! Kids all over Africa, and everywhere else, just love to play.

What's Football All About?

Football is a game where two teams try to kick a ball into the other team's goal. It's a team sport, which means everyone works together. You need to be fast, smart, and a good friend to your teammates. **Did you know?** Football is also called soccer in some places like America! But no matter what you call it, it's the most popular sport on Earth!

Why Do We Need Rules?

Imagine playing football without any rules. It would be very messy, right? Someone might push, someone might grab the ball with their hands (and not be the goalie!), and no one would know what to do. Rules make games fair and fun! They tell us what we can and cannot do. Like, you can't touch the ball with your hands, unless you are the special goalie. And you have to stay on your side of the field. Rules help everyone play nicely and make sure that the game is safe. When everyone follows the rules, the game is super exciting because everyone has a fair chance to win!

Who Makes Sure Rules Are Followed?

In a real football game, there's a special person called a referee. The referee blows a whistle and makes sure everyone follows the rules. He's like a super judge for the game! But for all the big football teams in a whole country, there's an even bigger boss. This boss makes sure all the teams and clubs follow the rules. He's like the super, super referee for all the teams. We call this special boss a 'regulator'. His job is to look after the big rules for all the football teams in a country. He helps keep everything fair and square. **Did you know?** A referee wears a special uniform, often black, so everyone can easily see them on the field!

Meet Our Story's Hero: The Rule Keeper!

In England, a country far away from us, there is a special 'regulator' for football. His name is not mentioned here, but he is a very important person. His job is to make sure that all the football clubs in England play by the same fair rules. He wants everyone to have a good chance and that no one gets special treatment. He really believes that football should be fair for every single team. He thinks that's the only way for football to be truly great and exciting for everyone who loves it.

What About Manchester City?

Manchester City is a very famous and big football team in England. Maybe you've seen them play on TV! They have many talented players and lots of fans. Like all big teams, Manchester City also has to follow the rules that the 'regulator' sets.
